content:
claire (acct): TritonBridge sent back the RFI. They want a 10-business-day POC, private deploy into their AWS account, FIPS 140-2 HSM, and a 12-month committed pricing schedule. Also asked for a one-page capability matrix and a plain-language key custody statement. Can we scope quickly?

ethan (solutions): Quick checklist: NDA first, confirm HSM vendor/model, network egress rules, and exact latency SLO (they requested p95 <55ms for 32-token chat). Also they want a short POC commercial term (discounted).

jorge (eng): 55ms p95 is doable with int8 on redwood-13B or int4 on a 70B with our appliance, depends on prompt lengths and QPS. Need expected peak RPS and distribution of reply lengths. HSM: we support KMIP & CloudHSM; on-prem HSM will need a reachable management endpoint and KMIP connectivity.

lina (sec): Key custody for Private: customer-kept keys only. Draft language: "Customer retains exclusive control over key material. Redwood stores encrypted key references and never has access to plaintext keys for Private deployments." I'll put that into the RFI appendix.

claire (acct): Can we offer a POC price at 40% off committed list for up to 14 days? They asked for tiers: 4/16/48 GPUs. Keep conservative.

ethan (solutions): Proposed commercial snippet: "POC: 40% off committed list for up to 14 days. Committed tiers: small(4 GPUs), mid(16), large(48). Per-GPU monthly list price + committed discount table attached." I'll draft CSV.

jorge (eng): For the capability matrix I'll include rows: redwood-7B/13B/70B; columns: quant (fp16/int8/int4), p95 latency (32/64 tokens), throughput per GPU, estimated $/token committed. Example row: ```redwood-13B | int8 | 42ms p95 (32t) | 100 req/s per A10 | $0.0009/token (committed)```

ethan (solutions): Add a short evaluation plan: smoke in hosted staging (2 days), private deploy in customer VPC (5 days), perf + quality runs (3 days), final report + capability one-pager + pricing CSV. Deliverables: RFI appendix, runbook, and eval artifacts.

claire (acct): They want the exec one-pager by EOD PST. Jorge, can you produce a one-pager latency/quality caveat line we can use? Keep it high-level for execs.

jorge (eng): Will do. Exec caveat example: "Latency estimates assume committed Dedicated capacity in the customer's region and quantization settings noted; production p95 depends on prompt distribution and KV cache hit rates."

lina (sec): Also request their compliance prompts (PII examples) to run hallucination/redaction tests. We'll need those plus an infra contact for HSM firmware access.

infra-bot: Ticket #POC-6120 created: assignees ethan, jorge, lina. Due 2024-11-12.

ethan (solutions): Uploading RFI_answers_triton_v1.docx and capability_onepager_triton_v1.pdf now (attachments). Please review and flag security/latency wording.

claire (acct): Thanks. I'll ask the customer for NDA, HSM vendor/model/firmware, VPC CIDR + peering info, allowed ports, expected peak RPS, and sample prompts in the handoff email. Will circulate NDA link once legal signs. :thumbsup:

jorge (eng): One technical note to include in RFI: quantization may slightly degrade rare-token fidelity; recommend running their critical prompt set during the POC in both int8 and fp16 to compare. I'll attach a small eval script snippet: ```python
# run eval
for cfg in ["fp16","int8"]:
  run_eval(cfg, prompts)
```

lina (sec): Added key custody blurb to the draft RFI. Also calling out that for Hosted we offer optional Redwood-managed KMS; for Private we require customer-managed KMS/HSM.

claire (acct): Great. Please get the one-pager + pricing CSV to me in the next 3 hours; I want to forward to the customer with the NDA link.
